No motion por código, o vídeo é uma pági: In motion graphics as code, the video is a page that knows how to draw any instant. A headless browser asks for frame 0, then 1, then 2, and FFmpeg stitches them into an MP4. If the same input always gives the same frames, you can redo, fix, and version the video like code. In this lesson you prove it on your own machine.

Quem decide qual instante a composição d: Who decides which instant the composition draws?
O motor de render, que pede um tempo exa: The render engine, which asks for an exact time on every frame.
O navegador, desenhando na velocidade qu: The browser, drawing at whatever speed the machine can manage.
O FFmpeg, que escolhe os quadros ao junt: FFmpeg, which picks the frames when it assembles the MP4.
A placa de vídeo, conforme a carga do co: The graphics card, depending on the computer's load.
O motor pede o instante (2,5 s, quadro 7: The engine asks for the instant (2.5 s, frame 75) and the composition draws that instant. That's why the render doesn't depend on the machine's speed: a slow machine takes longer, but gives the same frames.
Dois renders da mesma composição deram 8: Two renders of the same composition came out with 89 of 90 frames different. What should you look for first?
Um codificador diferente entre os dois r: A different encoder between the two renders.
Math.random, Date.now ou busca na rede d: Math.random, Date.now, or a network fetch inside the composition.
Running out of memory on the second render.
A font that didn't load in time.
Acaso dentro da composição é a causa mai: Randomness inside the composition is the most common cause, and the lint points to Math.random by line. Both renders used the same hyperframes@0.8.176 and the same FFmpeg: what changed was the input.
Para que serve o sorteio com semente?: What is a seeded random draw for?
Para o render ficar mais rápido em máqui: To make the render faster on a slow machine.
Para o lint parar de reclamar sem mudar: To make the lint stop complaining without changing anything in the result.
Para a variedade se repetir igual em tod: To make the variety repeat identically on every render.
Para cada render sair com uma versão nov: To make each render come out as a new, different version.
A semente fixa a sequência de números: o: The seed fixes the sequence of numbers: the points are still scattered, but always in the same places. Changing the seed changes the pattern on purpose, and again in a repeatable way.
Por que comparar quadro a quadro e não o: Why compare frame by frame and not the whole MP4?
Porque o md5sum não consegue ler arquivo: Because md5sum can't read large MP4 files.
Porque comparar quadros é bem mais rápid: Because comparing frames is much faster than reading the file.
Porque o FFmpeg só sabe gerar hash de qu: Because FFmpeg can only hash frames, not files.
Porque metadados mudam o arquivo com ima: Because metadata changes the file even when the images are identical.
O que interessa é a imagem. O framemd5 d: What matters is the image. framemd5 decodes each frame and compares the pixels; the hash of the whole file also changes with metadata that never shows on screen.
O vídeo é uma página que desenha qualque: The video is a page that draws any instant the engine asks for.
Mesma entrada, mesmos quadros: é o que d: Same input, same frames: that's what lets you fix one detail without redoing the rest.
Sorteio com semente, tempo do motor e da: Seeded draw, engine time, and data saved in the folder; the lint keeps watch.

#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"karaoke.py:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""karaoke.py — turns transcript.json (word + timing) into legendas.js for the composition.

Usage:  python3 karaoke.py transcript.json --inicio 0.5 --por-linha 3 > legendas.js

--inicio     seconds at which the narration starts in the video (the <audio> data-start)
--por-linha  words per caption (default 3)
Prints to stderr: "palavras: N · legendas: M".
"""
import argparse
import json
import sys


def main():
    a = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    a.add_argument("transcript")
    a.add_argument("--inicio", type=float, default=0.0)
    a.add_argument("--por-linha", type=int, default=3)
    o = a.parse_args()
    palavras = json.load(open(o.transcript, encoding="utf-8"))
    linhas = []
    for i in range(0, len(palavras), o.por_linha):
        grupo = palavras[i:i + o.por_linha]
        linhas.append({
            "inicio": round(grupo[0]["start"] + o.inicio, 3),
            "fim": round(grupo[-1]["end"] + o.inicio, 3),
            "palavras": [{"t": p["text"], "inicio": round(p["start"] + o.inicio, 3)} for p in grupo],
        })
    # each caption leaves 0.15 s after the last word, but never after the next one enters
    for atual, prox in zip(linhas, linhas[1:] + [None]):
        atual["fim"] = round(min(atual["fim"] + 0.15, prox["inicio"]) if prox else atual["fim"] + 0.15, 3)
    print("window.LEGENDAS = " + json.dumps(linhas, ensure_ascii=False) + ";")
    print(f"palavras: {len(palavras)} · legendas: {len(linhas)}", file=sys.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
